********************************************************************************
FlashInfer version history
********************************************************************************

This table lists previous versions of the ROCm FlashInfer Docker image for
installation and testing. For detailed information about available models, 
see the version-specific documentation. You can find tagged
previous releases of the ``ROCm/flashinfer`` Docker image on `Docker Hub 
<https://hub.docker.com/r/rocm/flashinfer/tags>`__.

   :header-rows: 1

   * - Release
     - Version
     - Components
     - Resources

     - `v0.2.5 <https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/releases/tag/v0.2.5>`__
     - 
       * ROCm 7.1.1
       * Ubuntu 24.04
       * PyTorch 2.8.0
       * Python 3.12

     -
